description: List dated milestones that split a big assignment from a start date to the due date, with default steps for research, outline, draft, revise and proofread. Dates can be plain text, like Dec 12 or in 3 weeks. Example prompt: "Break my 6 hour essay due 2026-11-20 into milestones."

due_date.description: Due date. Use 2026-12-12, or plain text like Dec 12, next Friday or in 3 weeks.

start_date.description: Defaults to today. Use 2026-12-12, or plain text like Dec 12, next Friday or in 3 weeks.

steps.description: Custom steps with relative sizes. Defaults to research, outline, draft, revise, proofread.

name: list_assignment_milestones
title: List assignment milestones
